title: The Fallen Nest
text: A great nest has fallen from the canopy and burst open across the path, a tangle of branches and down and old bones. In the middle sits an egg the size of a shield, still warm. High above, something is screaming.

options.label: The strongest lifts the egg back to the canopy, to return it to its screaming parent.

outcomes.text: A cry of thanks comes from above. A feather as long as an arm drifts down, bringing luck.
The parent thinks you are stealing it. It comes down out of the sky, screaming.

options.label: Take the egg. A thing so rare is worth the risk.

outcomes.text: The rare egg rides warm against your back. All day a shadow circles above, waiting for its chance.

options.label: Leave it where it fell. It is not yours to save or to take.

outcomes.text: The canopy was watching. It lets you pass unharmed, and the road is easy.
At dusk you hear the mother searching for it. Then you hear her find your trail.
